svg.title: Agency audit flow: triage, full audit, route fixes, ship, track
svg.desc: Five steps. Triage the site with analyze_website_aeo, run the full 44-check audit for a baseline, let the aeo skill route each failing rule, ship the fixes and re-run, then track client questions in the dashboard. A loop arrow returns from shipping to the audit.
svg.text: Re-run after each batch of fixes
